snippet.title: The Cup - Demo Trailer | Free game demo on Steam October 10
snippet.description:
The Cup is a creature card battler, broadcast to the galaxy. Real animals from three nations, three a side. Drop all three of theirs and the match is yours.

The free demo is on Steam October 10. It has the tutorial this trailer is cut from, THE ROAD (five bouts against invasive species), and matches against the House. The full release, with Steam multiplayer, is November 10.

Wishlist it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5079520/The_Cup/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=episode&utm_campaign=demo-trailer

Card art by @chioart08, @prayogaardip, Ondřej Tichý and @tmcglynnart.
